description: A painted, dimly lit study. Two adult hands, in a patterned dark sleeve, hold small silver spherical objects covered in tiny raised dots, one lifted above a grey metal typewriter with a round black knob on its front. Papers sit in a wooden tray to the right, a desk lamp and stacked folders are behind, and a window with curtains is at the upper right. No visible text, frame or wall edge; the painting runs to all four edges.
